name: Look To The Stars
summary: In Duskwood, Viktori Prism'Antras looks beyond the canopy for answers to the forest's curse. He trusts observation over arcane superstition and asks you to gather parts for a telescope drawn up by his gnomish associate.

sections.title: Searching the Skies
sections.body: Viktori Prism'Antras sees Duskwood's troubles differently from many in fearful Darkshire. He doubts that black magic, curses, and restless dead alone explain the land's corruption. He believes answers may lie above the canopy. With blueprints from his gnomish partner, Cog, he plans to build an instrument for looking into the heavens.

sections.title: A Matter of Engineering
sections.body: Viktori needs a sturdy frame to begin building the stargazing instrument. Cog's plans call for a machined bronze tube, and Viktori asks you to find one. He trusts practical engineering and careful observation to shed light where mysticism has failed.

aliases: who gives look to the stars
faq.answer: Viktori Prism'Antras is a scholarly resident of Darkshire who seeks rational answers to Duskwood's corruption by studying the stars.

faq.q: Why does Viktori want to build a telescope?
faq.answer: Viktori believes the skies may hold a tangible answer to Duskwood's strange transformation, beyond what magic and local legends can explain.
Cog is Viktori's gnomish engineer friend, who drew the blueprints for the stargazing device.

faq.q: Where does one obtain a bronze tube?
faq.answer: Engineers craft bronze tubes. Travelers who cannot make one may find one through trade, at auction houses, or from traveling engineering peddlers with spare stock.

faq.q: Is this part of a longer questline?
aliases: how many look to the stars quests
faq.answer: Yes. It begins a longer effort to assemble and calibrate Viktori's stargazing apparatus in Darkshire.

faq.q: Why is Viktori looking for natural explanations in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Though undead and dark enchantments fill the forest, Viktori believes natural laws may govern its transformation. He studies the heavens in search of answers.

angles.text: Gnomish design and skilled metalwork drive Viktori's effort, giving engineers a direct hand in his study of the stars.
Viktori depends on his gnomish associate, Cog, whose craft brings order and reason to a dark corner of the kingdom.
Night Watch patrols fend off horrors along Darkshire's roads, while Viktori's project gives the town hope of understanding what poisoned their home.
